program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (same-pos? a b)
      (and (= (fst a) (fst b)) (= (snd a) (snd b))))
    (define (pos-in? p cells)
      (any? (lambda (q) (same-pos? p q)) cells))
    (define (full-col? c)
      (all? (lambda (r) (= (cell-at g r c) 5)) (range 0 h)))
    (define (full-row? r)
      (all? (lambda (c) (= (cell-at g r c) 5)) (range 0 w)))
    (define divider-cols (filter full-col? (range 0 w)))
    (define divider-rows (filter full-row? (range 0 h)))
    (if (and (empty? divider-cols) (empty? divider-rows))
        g
        (let* ((vertical? (not (empty? divider-cols)))
               (d (if vertical? (first divider-cols) (first divider-rows)))
               (red-obj (first (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 2)) (objects g 0))))
               (reflected
                 (map
                   (lambda (p)
                     (if vertical?
                         (list (fst p) (- (* 2 d) (snd p)))
                         (list (- (* 2 d) (fst p)) (snd p))))
                   (obj-cells red-obj))))
          (grid-from-fn h w
            (lambda (r c)
              (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
                (if (and (= v 0) (pos-in? (list r c) reflected)) 3 v))))))))
